prompt: How might an anti-hero respond if interviewed by a media journalist.....who asks the anti-hero..."But who are you, under the mask? Underneath it all?". Include quotes within quotes within quotes, at least 3 levels deep, alternating between double quotes and single quotes.
judge_reasoning: All candidates respond as an anti-hero to the journalist’s question, but none actually achieve the required “quotes within quotes within quotes” with at least 3 levels deep and alternating double/single quote nesting. This is a major instruction/format miss across the board. Among them, candidate 3 best stays focused on answering (and reframing) “who are you under the mask” with a coherent, character-consistent layered identity; candidate 1 is next, while candidates 2 and 4 are more abstract or drift more.
